 This Crl.P Is Filed U/

For The Petitioner Praying To Give A Necessary
Direction To The Honble Additional Civil Judge And
Jmfc Anekal To Dispose Of The Criminal Case As
Expenditiously As Possible Against The Petitioner In
C.C.No.1108/2011 For An Offence P/U/S.498-A, 506,114
R/W Sec.34 Of Ipc.
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The captioned petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. seeking necessary direction to dispose of the proceedings in C.C.No.1108/2011 pending on the file of Additional Civil Judge and JMFC,
Anekal, for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506, 114 read with Section 34 of IPC.
2.
The petitioner is facing trial for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506, 114 read with Section 34 of IPC.
The grievance of the petitioner is that these proceedings are pending since 2011 and therefore, is seeking for an appropriate direction to expedite the matter and conclude the trial.
3. On examining the records, it is noticed that the trial is pending for almost 12 years for an offence punishable under Section 498A.
Therefore, I am of the view that this is a fit case, by exercising inherent jurisdiction, an appropriate direction needs to be given to decide the case as expeditiously as possible.

4. Hence, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is allowed.

(ii) The learned Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Anekal, is hereby directed to decide the criminal case pending in C.C.No.1108/2011 for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506, 114 read with Section 34 of IPC, as expeditiously as possible.
